project.name: LEADGEN
project.purpose: Lead generation, website auditing, PDF reporting, and outreach operations.
project.status: Phase 0 control plane established; audit integrity remediation not started.

data_flow: audit_results JSON plus mapped Audit columns
critical_rules: Runtime code is authoritative; record documentation drift explicitly.
Preserve existing lead, campaign, CRM, outreach, and scraping behavior unless the task authorizes a change.
Use factor_registry.json for all audit-factor changes.
known_issues: DOCUMENTATION_DRIFT: prose says 55 factors; runtime builds 62.
INTEGRITY_GAP: Audits.jsx hard-codes 53 rows and omits 9 executable factors.
SCORE_RISK: score lookup falls back to 5 for unknown factor IDs.
RESILIENCE_RISK: a factor exception can abort the full audit; crawl errors are converted to an empty completed crawl.
DATA_RISK: mapper parses display messages to obtain numeric DB values.
CLASSIFIER_RISK: classifier errors fall back to REAL.
STATE_RISK: current AuditStatus lacks COMPLETE, PARTIAL, and BLOCKED.
next_action: Obtain approval for Phase 1 audit-integrity changes; do not implement them in this phase.
